newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch central bank says not selling gold.
newsitem.headline: Dutch central bank says not selling gold.

text.p: The Dutch central bank said on Tuesday it was not currently selling gold from its reserves.
"Well you know we had done it several months ago, but at the moment we are not in the market," Nederlandsche Bank spokesman Bert Groothof said.
The bank announced in January it had sold 300 tonnes of gold for about 6.4 billion guilders.
Dealers said on Tuesday there were rumours in New York that an unnamed European central bank had been selling gold from its reserves. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
